services.name: Morning Sail
services.desc: Sunset Sail About There is no better way to see Kennebunkport than from the water. Our local captain and crew are happy to explain points of interest or let you sit back and relax. Enjoy Pineapple hospitality while you soak up the sun & salt air. You are welcome to help haul line, set sail or take a turn at the helm. We will be serving complimentary soda & water. Feel free to pack something to eat along with your favorite

services.name: Mid-Day Sail
services.desc: Come aboard The Pineapple Ketch for the perfect end of your day in Kennebunkport. This romantic hour and a half Maine sunset cruise takes you out the mouth of the Kennebunk river and up the rocky coast of Kennebunkport. Kennebunkport sunset sails are not only for couples but anyone who dreams of sailing with soft light bouncing off the water and illuminating our stunning shoreline. Evening sails depart from the Nonantum Resort in Kennebunkport. You’ll find great sailing during the hours prior to sunset. Complimentary soda and water are provided but we encourage you to bring whatever snack or beverage you would like to enjoy on your trip. Perhaps something bubbly to toast the end of another

services.name: Sip & Sail Wine Sail
services.desc: Wine and Sail Tour, Step aboard the Pineapple Ketch for a 90 minute coastal escape blending the scenic wonder of the Kennebunkport coastline with a curated selection of wines and an artisanal charcuterie cup served by Betsy Ross of Wine House on Maine. This intimate experience welcomes up to 10 guests for a beautiful evening. Betsy Ross is a Certified Sommelier and the owner of Wine House on Main in Kennebunk, Maine. With over 20 years of experience in hospitality, Betsy has built wine programs and led service teams at some of the nation’s most iconic venues—including Michelin-starred restaurants in San Francisco, the Metropolitan Museum of Art, and the U.S. Open in New York. With Trip Protection: If trip protection has been purchased guests may cancel or reschedule up to 2 hours prior to trip departure.
In the event of a cancellation all guests will be offered the choice of rescheduling to a new date or receiving a full refund.
No-Show Policy: Guests who fail to arrive for their scheduled departure, will not receive a refund.
Late Arrival: Guests are encouraged to arrive to the boat at least 15 minutes before the scheduled departure time.
If you miss the boat, it will be considered a no-show and no refund will be issued.
You can also cancel or reschedule via the link in your confirmation email.
